## Primary Services & Capabilities
1. **Full-Stack Web Development:** Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, high-converting landing pages, SaaS platforms, e-commerce storefronts, and performance engineering.
2. **Autonomous AI Agents:** 24/7 WhatsApp AI agents, Instagram DM/comment automation engines, AI sales qualification reps, customer support agents with schema-validated tool execution and memory.
3. **Conversational Voice AI Systems:** Sub-800ms low-latency inbound & outbound calling assistants powered by WebSockets, Deepgram Nova-2, and Cartesia/ElevenLabs neural synthesis.
4. **Custom CRM & Internal Operations Hubs:** Bespoke sales pipelines, lead routing databases, and business management portals built on Next.js and Supabase/PostgreSQL.
5. **n8n Workflow Automation:** Resilient enterprise workflow orchestration, connecting webhooks, Gmail, WhatsApp, Stripe, and internal databases with automatic retry and dead-letter queues.
6. **Technical & Semantic SEO / Core Web Vitals:** 100/100 performance scores, schema-enforced entity graphs, AEO passage extraction, and modern search engine optimization.

## Verified Production Case Studies & Systems
- **CleanData AI (B2B SaaS):** Autonomous data cleaning specialist featuring 10 operating modes, PII masking, embedded SQLite query engine, and multi-vector RAG synchronization.
- **Instagram Multimodal AI Agent & CRM:** Real-time Meta Graph API engine with voice note audio transcription via Groq Whisper, Vision LLM image understanding, live typing status, and dedicated Next.js CRM.
- **Sub-800ms Voice Calling Assistant:** Custom WebSocket Twilio streaming architecture delivering real-time human conversational flow with instantaneous barge-in.
